Funeral hymns in Tonic Solfa

Hymns of comfort and of the hope of the resurrection, for a funeral, a wake or a memorial service. Here are the 5 hymns on NoteFusion, each with the solfa written under the words, staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

AdventChristmasEpiphanyLentHoly WeekGood FridayEasterAscensionHalloweenThanksgivingHoly CommunionEveningFuneral

  • A Pilgrim and a Stranger

    A Pilgrim and a stranger,

    Doh is C4/4Tune: PASSION CHORALESolfa PDF

  • Abide with Me

    Abide with me; fast falls the eventide;

    Doh is Eb4/4Tune: EVENTIDESolfa PDF

  • Come Forth! Come on, with Solemn Song!

    Come forth! come on, with solemn song!

    Doh is F4/4Tune: JEG HAR MIN SAG TIL GUD HJEMSTILTSolfa PDF

  • The Grave Itself a Garden Is

    The grave itself a garden is,

    Doh is G3/4Tune: BELMONTSolfa PDF

  • Though in the Midst of Life We Be

    Though in midst of life we be,

    Doh is C4/4Tune: MITTEN WIR IM LEBEN SINDSolfa PDF
